hunks.baseline: Sometimes, no matter how you live, your true feelings just don’t reach the other person.
hunks.sol: Sometimes, your true feelings just don’t get through to the other person.

hunks.baseline: It was sad to cause a misunderstanding you’d never intended, but in a way, it couldn’t be helped.
hunks.sol: It was sad to cause a misunderstanding I’d never intended, but there was nothing I could do about it.

hunks.baseline: It wasn’t the kind of relationship you could fix by talking in the first place.
hunks.sol: We weren’t going to settle this by talking anyway.

hunks.baseline: The words died before he could finish, leaving only a breath that scattered into the air.
hunks.sol: The words trailed off before he could finish them.

hunks.baseline: The professor—or rather, the North Heaven Demon Lord—seemed dizzy with rage. His face twisted as he steadied his breathing.
hunks.sol: The professor—or rather, the North Heaven Demon Lord—looked dizzy with rage. His face twisted as he steadied his breathing.

hunks.baseline: I spoke first, taking the words right out of the mouth of a guy who looked like he was struggling.
hunks.sol: Since he seemed to be struggling, I spoke for him.

hunks.baseline: “That’s what you were going to say, right? I’ve heard it plenty of times. I know.”
hunks.sol: “That’s what you were going to say, right? I’ve heard it plenty of times.”

hunks.baseline: “Come on. People should be able to say what they want. Even if they’re shameless pill-popping bastards.”
hunks.sol: “Come on. A man has to say what’s on his mind. Even a shameless pill-popping bastard.”

hunks.baseline: “But I’ve heard that line so many times, it’s starting to feel a little stale. ‘I’ll tear your mouth open so you can never wag that unruly tongue again.’ Doesn’t that have a bit more flavor?”
hunks.sol: “But I’ve heard that line so many times, it feels a little stale. ‘I’ll tear your mouth open so you can never wag that unruly tongue again.’ Doesn’t that have more flavor?”

hunks.baseline: “You’re truly impossible to deal with using words.”
hunks.sol: “Words truly are wasted on you.”

hunks.baseline: “You won’t manage with force, either. The guys who said that to me and died could line up in a column, count off, and stretch twice around the Murim Alliance training ground.”
hunks.sol: “Force won’t work either. The guys who said that to me and died could line up in formation, count off, and circle the Murim Alliance training ground twice.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang, standing beside me, added, “For the record, mine would stretch more than ten times around.”
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang, standing beside me, added, “For the record, mine would circle it more than ten times.”

hunks.baseline: “If you don’t like it, then live a long, healthy life yourself.”
hunks.sol: “If you don’t like it, live a long, healthy life yourself.”

hunks.baseline: “You lived a long, sickly life. Don’t you remember? When I first met you…”
hunks.sol: “You’ve lived a long, sickly life. Don’t you remember? When I first met you…”

hunks.baseline: A sharp whistle swallowed the words that were about to follow.
hunks.sol: A sharp whistle swallowed the rest of my words.

hunks.baseline: I ducked on instinct, without a moment’s hesitation. A dagger shot past overhead at the speed of a streak of light and slammed into the cliff face.
hunks.sol: I ducked on instinct. A dagger streaked over my head like a beam of light and slammed into the cliff face.

hunks.baseline: It hit with the force of a cannonball.
hunks.sol: It struck with the force of a cannonball.

hunks.baseline: I brushed off the grit that had jumped up with the shock wave and stared wide-eyed at the North Heaven Demon Lord, who had thrown the dagger.
hunks.sol: I brushed off the grit thrown up by the shock wave and stared wide-eyed at the North Heaven Demon Lord, who had thrown the dagger.

hunks.baseline: “Those pills really do make you strong. Old Master, I don’t think I could take him one-on-one by myself.”
hunks.sol: “Those pills really do make you strong. Old Master, I’d never beat him one-on-one.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang frowned. “Do you even need to ask? Of course you couldn’t. If you keep doing what you’ve been doing, you might have a chance in a year or two.”
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang frowned. “Was that even a question? Of course you wouldn’t. Keep going as you have been, though, and in another year or two, you might have a chance.”

hunks.baseline: Considering Jeok Cheongang knew my past and even my deepest secrets, that was a fairly reasonable assessment. But to someone listening, it was an intolerable insult.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang knew my past and even my deepest secrets, so it was a fairly reasonable assessment. To someone listening, though, it was an intolerable insult.

hunks.baseline: “Give your command.”
hunks.sol: “Give your command, my lord.”

hunks.baseline: The old nomad, Jamukha, trembled.
hunks.sol: The old nomad Jamukha’s eyelids trembled.

hunks.baseline: “That is the very reason I have lived until now.”
hunks.sol: “That is the reason I have lived until now.”

hunks.baseline: “Today’s victory. And the head of Jin Taekyung, the Blazing Flame Divine Dragon.”
hunks.sol: “Today’s victory, and the head of Jin Taekyung, the Blazing Flame Divine Dragon.”

hunks.baseline: As he took a heavy step, the dark crimson energy rising around him like heat haze gathered thickly, turning into mist.
hunks.sol: With a heavy step, the dark crimson energy that had risen like heat haze gathered into a thick mist.

hunks.baseline: The two men had finally drawn out every last drop of their strength. Watching them, Jeok Cheongang spoke calmly.
hunks.sol: As the two men drew out every last drop of their strength, Jeok Cheongang spoke calmly.

hunks.baseline: “Do you have some kind of disease that makes blood gush from your seven apertures and kills you if you play along at a time like this?”
hunks.sol: “Will blood gush from your seven apertures and kill you if you play along for once?”

hunks.baseline: “What’s the point of playing along? We can’t even get our timing right. It’s much better to land one more hit on those bastards.”
hunks.sol: “What’s the point? We can’t even get our timing right. Better to land another hit on those bastards.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang’s gaze, fixed on the North Heaven Demon Lord and Jamukha as they approached slowly and cautiously, shifted to me.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang’s gaze shifted from the North Heaven Demon Lord and Jamukha, who were approaching slowly and cautiously, to me.

hunks.baseline: For a moment, I didn’t know what to say. Jeok Cheongang’s quiet voice reached my ear.
hunks.sol: For a moment, I didn’t know what to say. Then Jeok Cheongang’s quiet voice reached my ear.

hunks.baseline: “We never made any embarrassing promises to each other, but keep one thing in mind, as always.”
hunks.sol: “We’ve never made any embarrassing promises to each other, but as always, remember one thing.”

hunks.baseline: “What should I keep in mind…?”
hunks.sol: “What’s that?”

hunks.baseline: “So don’t do anything stupid like risking your life in a fight. Even if Yama comes for you, this old man will kick him in the ass and send him packing.”
hunks.sol: “So don’t do anything stupid like fighting to the death. Even if Yama comes for you, I’ll kick him in the ass and send him packing.”

hunks.baseline: The more I learned, the stranger it seemed.
hunks.sol: The more I thought about it, the stranger it seemed.

hunks.baseline: We were both human, made of flesh and blood, and yet our thoughts could be so completely different.
hunks.sol: People were all made of the same flesh and blood. How could they think so differently?

hunks.baseline: One person asked another to give up his life in return for everything he wanted. Another needed nothing at all—he only wanted the other person to survive.
hunks.sol: One person offered another everything he wanted in exchange for his life. Another asked for nothing—he only wanted the other person to survive.

hunks.baseline: “Nothing much. You’ve already been sick once, so a long, healthy life is out of the question. At least make sure you live a long, sickly one from now on.”
hunks.sol: “Nothing much. You’ve already been sick once, so a long, healthy life is out of the question. Just make sure you live a long, sickly one from now on.”

hunks.baseline: “Living a long time at my age, huh? Seems I have a good reason to live at least another hundred years.”
hunks.sol: “A long life at my age, huh? Seems I have a reason to live at least another hundred years.”

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang laughed heartily, clearly delighted.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang threw back his head and laughed, clearly delighted.

hunks.baseline: Beyond the darkness melting in the heat of two flames—alike, yet different—I stepped forward toward the ominously thick dark crimson mist.
hunks.sol: Beyond the darkness melting before those two flames—alike, yet different—
I stepped toward the ominously thick dark crimson mist.

hunks.baseline: No. We did, as if we’d made a promise to do so at the same time.
hunks.sol: No. *We* stepped forward together, as if we’d promised to.

hunks.baseline: Everyone who faced the mist—red as blood and frighteningly thick—felt a chill sink deep into their spines and stopped moving.
hunks.sol: Everyone who faced that mist, red as blood and frighteningly thick, felt a chill sink deep into their spines and stopped.

hunks.baseline: No. They had no choice but to stop.
hunks.sol: They had no choice.

hunks.baseline: Their instincts knew it before their reason could.
hunks.sol: Their instincts knew before their minds did.

hunks.baseline: That thick blanket of mist was energy made almost completely tangible. It was no different from a forest of blades and spears, ready to slice and tear anyone who entered to pieces.
hunks.sol: The qi hanging thick in the air had become almost tangible. Entering it would be like walking into a forest of blades and spears, ready to slice and tear their bodies apart.

hunks.baseline: But the biggest reason so many people from Shanxi were held back was the terrifying battle raging inside that dangerous space.
hunks.sol: But the greatest reason so many people from Shanxi were held back was the terrifying battle raging inside it.

hunks.baseline: Was there any phrase that could describe what was happening better than “heaven and earth overturned”?
hunks.sol: What could describe the scene better than *heaven and earth shaking*?

hunks.baseline: Beyond the mist, writhing like a living creature, four Supreme Peak masters were entangled with one another at the speed of flashes of light.
hunks.sol: Beyond the mist, which writhed like a living creature, four Supreme Peak masters clashed at blinding speed.

hunks.baseline: The wrinkles had vanished from his face with his regained youth. Pale light-flames surged over his knuckles.
hunks.sol: Pale light-flames surged over the fist of a man whose regained youth had erased his wrinkles.

hunks.baseline: A tremendous blaze, brought to the tenth level of mastery after more than a century of training, erupted.
hunks.sol: A tremendous blaze erupted from a technique he had brought to the tenth level of mastery through more than a century of training.

hunks.baseline: It stained the air and shot toward the enemy before him—toward the North Heaven Demon Lord.
hunks.sol: It lit the air as it shot toward the enemy before him—toward the North Heaven Demon Lord.

hunks.baseline: But even amid the enormous impact, which melted the ground and shook the cliff walls, the North Heaven Demon Lord’s figure blurred in the final instant and disappeared.
hunks.sol: The ground melted and the cliff walls shook, but at the last instant, the North Heaven Demon Lord’s figure blurred and vanished.

hunks.baseline: Or, more accurately, it disappeared from the sight of a human with such obvious limits.
hunks.sol: Or rather, it vanished from human sight, with all its limitations.

hunks.baseline: A tiny, faint whistle slipped quietly into his ear.
hunks.sol: A tiny whistle reached Jeok Cheongang’s ear.

hunks.baseline: But Jeok Cheongang knew well that movement beyond sound could fool even hearing.
hunks.sol: But he knew well that movement faster than sound could fool his hearing, too.

hunks.baseline: He could feel it.
hunks.sol: He felt it.

hunks.baseline: His opponent’s presence, descending from the invisible space above his head.
hunks.sol: His opponent’s presence, plunging down from the unseen space above his head.

hunks.baseline: And, at the same time, the massive Force carried on the spearhead that thrust forward, erasing the wind in its wake.
hunks.sol: And the immense Force riding the spearhead as it thrust forward, erasing the wind in its path.

hunks.baseline: The dark crimson mist that had wrapped around the area scattered in an instant.
hunks.sol: The dark crimson mist surrounding them scattered in an instant.

hunks.baseline: The full force of Flame Divine Palm surged upward in a pillar of fire.
hunks.sol: Flame Divine Palm, unleashed at full strength, surged upward as a pillar of fire.

hunks.baseline: He aimed it at his opponent, who had tried to erase his presence as much as possible, but whose immense energy made it impossible to conceal him completely.
hunks.sol: It raced toward an opponent who had tried to hide his presence, but whose immense energy made it impossible to conceal himself completely.

hunks.baseline: And in the next moment, Jeok Cheongang realized something anew.
hunks.sol: And in the next moment, Jeok Cheongang understood all over again.

hunks.baseline: The North Heaven Demon Lord, drawing on the power of the Temporary Strength Pill, was a great enemy who could look down on even him—who had reached his current realm through several breakthroughs in insight—as half a step beneath him.
hunks.sol: With the Temporary Strength Pill’s power behind him, the North Heaven Demon Lord could look down on even Jeok Cheongang—who had reached his current realm through several moments of enlightenment—as half a step beneath him.

hunks.baseline: The spearhead pierced a single precise point.
hunks.sol: The spearhead pierced straight through a single point.

hunks.baseline: The immense Force carried at its tip split the flames that seemed capable of burning the whole world. The distance between the two men vanished.
hunks.sol: The immense Force at its tip split flames that had seemed capable of burning the whole world, and the distance between the two men vanished.

hunks.baseline: Overwhelmed by that force, Jeok Cheongang’s eyes widened.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang’s eyes widened at the overwhelming force.

hunks.baseline: This wasn’t a question of martial enlightenment.
hunks.sol: This wasn’t a question of enlightenment in the martial arts.

hunks.baseline: The North Heaven Demon Lord’s movements, enhanced to an extreme, made everything possible—along with internal energy so powerful it made Jeok Cheongang wonder if he had drawn out every last bit of his innate qi.
hunks.sol: The North Heaven Demon Lord’s internal energy was so immense that Jeok Cheongang wondered if he had drawn out every last bit of his innate qi. That, combined with his greatly enhanced speed, made it possible.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang swallowed the curse rising to his lips and pulled up every ounce of his internal energy.
hunks.sol: Swallowing the curse rising to his lips, Jeok Cheongang drew on all the internal energy in his body.

hunks.baseline: He slammed both hands together against the spearhead plunging toward his chest.
hunks.sol: He slammed his hands together around the spearhead plunging toward his chest.

hunks.baseline: Dark crimson Force that his Body-Protecting Qi could not fully stop tore into his flesh and bones. Jeok Cheongang clenched his teeth to endure the pain.
hunks.sol: Dark crimson Force tore into flesh and bone despite his Body-Protecting Qi. Jeok Cheongang clenched his teeth against the pain.

hunks.baseline: The pain of his molars breaking was nothing beside what he felt in his two hands, growing more mangled by the second.
hunks.sol: The pain of breaking a molar was nothing beside what came from his hands as they grew more mangled by the second.

hunks.baseline: As Jeok Cheongang swallowed the blood surging up his throat and held on to the spearhead, the North Heaven Demon Lord bared his teeth in a grin.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang swallowed the blood rising in his throat and held fast to the spearhead. The North Heaven Demon Lord bared his teeth in a grin.

hunks.baseline: A mocking voice slipped between Jeok Cheongang’s clenched teeth.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang’s reply came through clenched teeth, edged with mockery.

hunks.baseline: “I’ll give you that advice right back.”
hunks.sol: “Right back at you.”

hunks.baseline: The North Heaven Demon Lord’s eyes sank.
hunks.sol: The North Heaven Demon Lord’s eyes darkened.

hunks.baseline: He, too, could feel with his whole body that Jeok Cheongang’s words weren’t an empty boast.
hunks.sol: He could feel throughout his body that Jeok Cheongang wasn’t bluffing.

hunks.baseline: The spearhead was clearly being driven forward with all his strength, yet it could go no farther.
hunks.sol: Though he drove it with all his strength, the spearhead could go no farther.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang’s skin was crushed by the Force, but his toes were dug deep into the ground, perfectly still.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang’s skin was being crushed by the Force, yet his feet, dug deep into the ground, did not budge.

hunks.baseline: The old monster of Mount Jiuhua, returned decades younger, was far stronger than the North Heaven Demon Lord remembered.
hunks.sol: The old monster of Mount Jiuhua had returned decades younger—and far stronger than the North Heaven Demon Lord remembered.

hunks.baseline: Strong enough that even now, after taking the Temporary Strength Pill, he couldn’t knock him down easily.
hunks.sol: Strong enough that even after taking the Temporary Strength Pill, he couldn’t bring him down easily.

hunks.baseline: It ends here.
hunks.sol: It ended here.

hunks.baseline: As that thought took shape, the North Heaven Demon Lord twisted the spear shaft.
hunks.sol: The moment that thought formed, the North Heaven Demon Lord twisted the spear shaft with every ounce of strength he had.

hunks.baseline: With every ounce of strength he could bring to bear.
Enough to make even Jeok Cheongang unable to endure the pain this time.
hunks.sol: This time, even Jeok Cheongang would be unable to bear the pain.

hunks.baseline: At the grisly sound of flesh splitting, Jeok Cheongang’s body trembled. Then a thunderous shout burst from between Jamukha’s lips.
hunks.sol: At the grisly sound of flesh tearing, Jeok Cheongang’s body shuddered. Then a thunderous shout burst from Jamukha’s lips.
